compatibility_boundaries: Native extension callbacks use DenyBridge for mutation/provider/process actions. Dynamic registration is rejected by catalog fencing until a new admitted host binding. P09 exposes separately tested native provider/action broker primitives; P12 owns final compatibility client routing. Static extension execution is trusted host-account code, effects are Unknown, and is never an OS sandbox.

Provider payload callbacks cannot replace selected model, tools, stream or host credentials/endpoint. Changed payload values add to hard admission accounting. This explicit authority boundary intentionally narrows arbitrary source payload mutation.

Branch navigation rejects unresolved tool boundaries. Summary and label publish together through the journal; source fork-label ancestry and plan-discard/review defects are corrected as recorded in BUGS_AND_TECH_DEBT.

Restart inspection is host-only, scoped and evidence-bound. It does not adopt PIDs, signal imported processes or replay effects. Previous job/process records are historical; host evidence must establish settlement. No fabricated verification passes are inherited from jobs or model reports.

P12 owns slash parsing, full skill invocation/template client expansion, SDK/CLI/JSONL and visual/UI request adapters under D05; native prompt/steer/follow_up accept already routed text. Direct source steer/followUp omit input hooks; native direct queue delivery does too.

A48 native branch/fork/summary and storage lossless/compatible export are delivered; HTML/diagnostics export presentation is P12. No hidden TypeScript AgentSession in product runtime or extension helper.

Verification is mode-selected, request-local and native-receipt-bound. Later mutation or Unknown effects invalidate prior checks. Concrete browser/native/Godot target adapters are P11; generic capability ports remain explicit.
